column1: # Installer exceptions: one recipe per app that native mise cannot own.
# Tab-separated columns: profile, name, and optional flags.
#   profile  base (every profile) or one name from [vars] dots_profiles
#              install-only    dots up only installs it when missing (the app updates itself)
#              hold=PACKAGE    the recipe pins PACKAGE (e.g. brew:kanata); dots add refuses it
